didYouKnow: Japan is made up of more than 14,000 islands.
Japan's imperial house is the oldest continuous hereditary monarchy in the world.
Around 70% of Japan is covered by mountains.
content.about: Japan is an island nation in East Asia, made up of four main islands and thousands of smaller ones. It mixes ancient temples and shrines with ultra-modern cities like Tokyo and Osaka. Its landscapes range from snowy northern mountains to subtropical beaches in Okinawa, and Mount Fuji is its best-known symbol. Japanese food, anime and bullet trains have fans all over the world.

standout.text: Japan opened the world's first high-speed railway, the Tōkaidō Shinkansen, in 1964.
